verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a domain registrar, so the axis applies. The pack shows no user-facing control over retention or deletion: nothing on account deletion, data export, or retention settings. The only related item is a community report that ID-verification data is deleted after the check passes, which describes a vendor policy rather than a control the user has. CRUD on DNS records is resource management, not data-retention control.
